rules.statement: A co-owner who plants more than his proportionate share of the common property is entitled to possess the entire plantation as against the other co-owners until such time as the common ownership is put an end to in an action for partition.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a co-owner plants more than his proportionate share of the common property he is entitled to possess the entire plantation as against the other co-owners till such time as the common ownership is put an end to in an action for partition.
